name: box
title: Box
description: A container with token-only padding, background, radius, border and shadow.

when: Giving a group of content padding or a surface without a card's semantics.

instead.when: The content is one object with a title.

builtIn: Renders a plain element; pass `as` for semantics.
youProvide: The right element through `as` (section, nav, aside…) when it has a role.

genui.description: A padded container. Use only theme values; prefer card for an object with a title.

Box.name: inputMode
Box.description: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its contents

Box.name: is
Box.description: Specify that a standard HTML element should behave like a defined custom built-in element

Box.name: aria-activedescendant
Box.description: Identifies the currently active element when DOM focus is on a composite widget, textbox, group, or application.

Box.name: aria-atomic
Box.description: Indicates whether assistive technologies will present all, or only parts of, the changed region based on the change notifications defined by the aria-relevant attribute.

Box.name: aria-autocomplete
Box.description:
Indicates whether inputting text could trigger display of one or more predictions of the user's intended value for an input and specifies how predictions would be
presented if they are made.

Box.name: aria-braillelabel
Box.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element, which is intended to be converted into Braille.

Box.name: aria-brailleroledescription
Box.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized abbreviated description for the role of an element, which is intended to be converted into Braille.

Box.name: aria-checked
Box.description: Indicates the current "checked" state of checkboxes, radio buttons, and other widgets.

Box.name: aria-colcount
Box.description: Defines the total number of columns in a table, grid, or treegrid.

Box.name: aria-colindex
Box.description: Defines an element's column index or position with respect to the total number of columns within a table, grid, or treegrid.

Box.name: aria-colindextext
Box.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-colindex.

Box.name: aria-colspan
Box.description: Defines the number of columns spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

Box.name: aria-controls
Box.description: Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current element.

Box.name: aria-current
Box.description: Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related elements.

Box.name: aria-describedby
Box.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

Box.name: aria-description
Box.description: Defines a string value that describes or annotates the current element.

Box.name: aria-details
Box.description: Identifies the element that provides a detailed, extended description for the object.

Box.name: aria-disabled
Box.description: Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise operable.

Box.name: aria-dropeffect
Box.description: Indicates what functions can be performed when a dragged object is released on the drop target.

Box.name: aria-errormessage
Box.description: Identifies the element that provides an error message for the object.

Box.name: aria-expanded
Box.description: Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded or collapsed.

Box.name: aria-flowto
Box.description:
Identifies the next element (or elements) in an alternate reading order of content which, at the user's discretion,
allows assistive technology to override the general default of reading in document source order.

Box.name: aria-grabbed
Box.description: Indicates an element's "grabbed" state in a drag-and-drop operation.

Box.name: aria-haspopup
Box.description: Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that can be triggered by an element.

Box.name: aria-hidden
Box.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

Box.name: aria-invalid
Box.description: Indicates the entered value does not conform to the format expected by the application.

Box.name: aria-keyshortcuts
Box.description: Indicates keyboard shortcuts that an author has implemented to activate or give focus to an element.

Box.name: aria-label
Box.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

Box.name: aria-labelledby
Box.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

Box.name: aria-level
Box.description: Defines the hierarchical level of an element within a structure.

Box.name: aria-live
Box.description: Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

Box.name: aria-modal
Box.description: Indicates whether an element is modal when displayed.

Box.name: aria-multiline
Box.description: Indicates whether a text box accepts multiple lines of input or only a single line.

Box.name: aria-multiselectable
Box.description: Indicates that the user may select more than one item from the current selectable descendants.

Box.name: aria-orientation
Box.description: Indicates whether the element's orientation is horizontal, vertical, or unknown/ambiguous.

Box.name: aria-owns
Box.description:
Identifies an element (or elements) in order to define a visual, functional, or contextual parent/child relationship
between DOM elements where the DOM hierarchy cannot be used to represent the relationship.

Box.name: aria-placeholder
Box.description:
Defines a short hint (a word or short phrase) intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value.
A hint could be a sample value or a brief description of the expected format.

Box.name: aria-posinset
Box.description: Defines an element's number or position in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

Box.name: aria-pressed
Box.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

Box.name: aria-readonly
Box.description: Indicates that the element is not editable, but is otherwise operable.

Box.name: aria-relevant
Box.type: "text" | "additions" | "additions removals" | "additions text" | "all" | "removals" | "removals additions" | "removals text" | "text additions" | "text removals"
Box.description: Indicates what notifications the user agent will trigger when the accessibility tree within a live region is modified.

Box.name: aria-required
Box.description: Indicates that user input is required on the element before a form may be submitted.

Box.name: aria-roledescription
Box.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized description for the role of an element.

Box.name: aria-rowcount
Box.description: Defines the total number of rows in a table, grid, or treegrid.

Box.name: aria-rowindex
Box.description: Defines an element's row index or position with respect to the total number of rows within a table, grid, or treegrid.

Box.name: aria-rowindextext
Box.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-rowindex.

Box.name: aria-rowspan
Box.description: Defines the number of rows spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

Box.name: aria-selected
Box.description: Indicates the current "selected" state of various widgets.

Box.name: aria-setsize
Box.description: Defines the number of items in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

Box.name: aria-sort
Box.description: Indicates if items in a table or grid are sorted in ascending or descending order.

Box.name: aria-valuemax
Box.description: Defines the maximum allowed value for a range widget.

Box.name: aria-valuemin
Box.description: Defines the minimum allowed value for a range widget.

Box.name: aria-valuenow
Box.description: Defines the current value for a range widget.

Box.name: aria-valuetext
Box.description: Defines the human readable text alternative of aria-valuenow for a range widget.
